name: Last.fm API
description: The Last.fm music API provides access to music data including artist info, album data, track information, user listening history, charts, and scrobbling. All requests use a single endpoint with method-based dispatch via the 'method' query parameter. Over 50 methods are available across artist, album, track, user, chart, geo, tag, library, and auth packages.
